shared_elements: hand/arm rendered in profile with detailed fingers
dense small-scale repeated surface texture (scale-like or dotted patterning)
horizontal register band organising the scene
justification: Both are shallow relief scenes with profile human figures whose hands and garments are rendered with dense, small repeated patterning, arranged in a horizontal register with rosette-like floral roundels appearing in the field; the treatment of fingers and of textured surfaces is comparable. However, B shows a specific scene of two attendants leading horned rams, while A shows a band of foliage/rosettes, textiles and a lone hand with no animals at all, so the actual subject matter and the relationships between elements differ substantially.
